question.question_text: Which is nearer to the utensil rack in the kitchen: the cooker or the dustbin?

answer_options.text: The dustbin is closer to the utensil rack in the kitchen
Both the cooker and the dustbin are at the same distance from the utensil rack
The cooker is closer to the utensil rack in the kitchen

shared_investigation.established_facts: The video consistently shows the cooker on the left side of the kitchen counter and the dustbin on the right side. The utensil rack is also consistently shown on the right side of the kitchen counter. However, the video does not provide clear visual information about the spatial arrangement of the cooker and the dustbin relative to the utensil rack.
shared_investigation.gap_reason: The video does not provide clear visual information about the spatial arrangement of the cooker and the dustbin relative to the utensil rack.
